# HTML to Figma (html2design)

> Convert HTML and CSS code into native, editable Figma layers instantly.

## What it is

HTML to Figma is a Figma plugin that converts HTML/CSS source code into native Figma design layers. It parses HTML structure and computed CSS styles, then recreates them as Figma frames, text layers, rectangles, and vector shapes.

## How it works

1. Open the plugin in Figma
2. Paste raw HTML/CSS code or select an HTML file
3. Configure scale and import preferences
4. Click Generate to receive native Figma layers

The plugin reads computed CSS values (not class names), so it works with any CSS framework: Tailwind, Bootstrap, plain CSS, CSS-in-JS, or Sass.

## Key capabilities

- Converts HTML elements to native Figma frames, rectangles, and text layers
- Preserves typography: font families, weights, sizes, line-heights, letter-spacing
- Preserves styling: colors, borders, shadows, gradients, opacity, border-radius
- Imports images as high-resolution fills and SVGs as native vector paths
- Generates a structured Figma layer hierarchy matching the HTML DOM tree
- Works with localhost, staging, and production HTML (no live URL required)

## What it does NOT do

- Does not convert CSS Flexbox to Figma Auto Layout (elements are positioned absolutely to match the rendered layout)
- Does not extract Figma Variables from CSS custom properties
- Does not preserve CSS animations or transitions
- Does not fetch live URLs (you paste the HTML, the plugin does not crawl)

## Use cases

- Legacy website migration to Figma design files
- Developer-to-designer handoff (reverse engineering code back to design)
- Competitor layout analysis and deconstruction
- Design system kickstart from existing implementations
- Converting React, Vue, or Angular component output to Figma
